universal.label: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
universal.description: India's pan-India single unified emergency number integrating Police (100), Fire (101), Ambulance (108), and Women/Child safety dispatch with GPS location tracking.

categories.name: Police & Public Safety
categories.description: Immediate law enforcement dispatch, crime reporting, and railway security.

numbers.label: Unified Police & Emergency Dispatch
numbers.audience: Anyone in immediate danger, witnessing a crime, or requiring urgent police intervention anywhere in India.
numbers.whenToUse: Call first for active crimes, assault, burglary, or threats to life. Connects to the nearest PCR van via ERSS GPS routing.

numbers.label: Traditional Police Control Room
numbers.audience: General public needing local police station or district control room dispatch.
numbers.whenToUse: Use if calling from a landline or region where legacy district PCR lines are preferred; automatically routes to 112 in most states.

numbers.label: Indian Railways Security & Medical Helpline (RailMadad)
numbers.audience: Train passengers experiencing theft, harassment, medical emergencies, or safety threats on board or at railway stations.
numbers.whenToUse: Call immediately while travelling on Indian Railways to alert Railway Protection Force (RPF) and station medical teams at the next halt.

categories.name: Medical & Ambulance
categories.description: Critical care trauma ambulances, maternal/neonatal transport, and mental health crisis support.

numbers.label: Emergency Trauma & Critical Care Ambulance
numbers.audience: General public facing any life-threatening medical emergency, trauma, heart attack, stroke, or severe accident.
numbers.whenToUse: Use for critical emergencies requiring Advanced or Basic Life Support (ALS/BLS) ambulances with paramedics. Note the difference from 102: 108 is the primary all-emergency trauma response fleet.

numbers.label: Janani Shishu Suraksha (Maternal & Neonatal Ambulance)
numbers.audience: Pregnant women, mothers in labor, newborns, and infants requiring hospital transport.
numbers.whenToUse: Use specifically for pregnancy transport, delivery referrals, and inter-facility neonatal transfers under National Health Mission (distinct from 108 general trauma ambulances).

numbers.label: Tele-MANAS National Mental Health Helpline
numbers.audience: Individuals experiencing acute emotional distress, suicidal ideation, panic attacks, or psychological crisis.
numbers.whenToUse: Call anytime for confidential, multilingual counselling and immediate psychiatric crisis escalation (also reachable at 1800-891-4416).

categories.name: Fire & Rescue
categories.description: Fire tenders, building collapse rescue, hazardous material leaks, and urban search.

numbers.label: Fire & Emergency Rescue Services
numbers.audience: Anyone reporting structural fires, electrical fires, LPG gas leaks, or trapped persons.
numbers.whenToUse: Call immediately when smoke or fire is detected or someone is trapped in an elevator, vehicle, or collapsed structure.

categories.name: Highway & Road Emergency
categories.description: Dedicated National Highway patrol ambulances, cranes, and road crash response.

numbers.label: NHAI National Highway Emergency Helpline
numbers.audience: Motorists, passengers, and bystanders on National Highways (NH) facing crashes, medical emergencies, or breakdowns.
numbers.whenToUse: Use on National Highways; reaches NHAI highway patrol ambulances, tow cranes, and plaza responders faster than general city lines.

numbers.label: Road Accident Emergency Service
numbers.audience: Drivers and Good Samaritans reporting severe traffic collisions on state and arterial roads.
numbers.whenToUse: Use to report road traffic crashes when you need coordinated police and trauma ambulance dispatch on state highways.

categories.name: Women & Child Safety
categories.description: Dedicated protection helplines for women in distress, domestic abuse, and children in need of care.

numbers.label: Women in Distress Police Helpline
numbers.audience: Women facing stalking, harassment, domestic violence, or immediate personal safety threats.
numbers.whenToUse: Call when a woman needs urgent police protection, safe escort, or immediate intervention from a Women's Cell.

numbers.label: Universal Women Helpline (One Stop Centre)
numbers.audience: Women seeking emergency shelter, legal aid, medical support, or domestic violence counselling.
numbers.whenToUse: Use to connect directly with Sakhi One Stop Centres for rescue, temporary shelter, and legal/psychological assistance.

numbers.label: Childline India Emergency Helpline
numbers.audience: Children in distress, runaway or missing children, or adults reporting child abuse, child labor, or abandonment.
numbers.whenToUse: Call immediately whenever a minor (under 18) needs rescue, shelter, medical care, or protection from abuse.

categories.name: Cyber Crime & Disaster
categories.description: Financial cyber fraud freeze line and National/State Disaster Management control rooms.

numbers.label: National Cyber Crime Helpline (I4C)
numbers.audience: Victims of UPI/banking fraud, unauthorized transactions, sextortion, or online identity theft.
numbers.whenToUse: Call within the 'Golden Hour' (immediately after money is debited) so banks and police can freeze the fraudulent transfer before withdrawal.

numbers.label: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)
numbers.audience: Citizens stranded or affected by floods, cyclones, earthquakes, landslides, or chemical disasters.
numbers.whenToUse: Call during natural or man-made disasters to request NDRF rescue boats, airlift coordination, or relief camp details.

numbers.label: State Disaster Control Room Helpline
numbers.audience: Residents needing state-level flood, cyclone, or heatwave relief and district collectorate coordination.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 1070 to reach your State Emergency Operations Centre (SEOC) or 1077 for the District Emergency Operations Centre.
